Read `/AGENTS.md` before proposing or changing code.

DSPDS is not a conventional score-first aim trainer. Preserve formal-assessment isolation, raw-input integrity, local-first storage, versioned data, and explainable analysis.

React owns menus and non-real-time UI. Three.js and typed engine modules own the simulation and render loop. Individual mouse samples must be captured outside the render loop and preserved for analysis. Assisted camera output must never replace raw movement in scoring.

Do not invent thresholds or scientific claims. Treat design values as illustrative unless the product specification defines them. Keep changes within the active milestone and include tests for deterministic behavior.
